title: Family Swimming at Lake Pier, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white 1940s vintage snapshot featuring a large family standing together on a small wooden pier at the edge of a pond or lake. A weeping willow tree arches overhead. The group consists of an adult man, several women, and young children dressed in period swimwear, including high-waisted two-piece suits and classic trunks. Two boys are partially submerged in the water next to the dock.
